import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_rng structure
class GSLRng(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Define the function prototypes
# gsl_rng_alloc allocates memory for the RNG
# gsl_rng_set sets the seed for the RNG
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng), ctypes.c_ulong]
gsl.gsl_rng_set.restype = None

def initialize_rng(seed):
    # Get the default RNG type
    gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, 'gsl_rng_default')

    # Allocate memory for the RNG
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl_rng_default)
    if not rng:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate memory for RNG")

    # Set the seed
    gsl.gsl_rng_set(rng, seed)

    return rng

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test with a specific seed
    seed = 123456
    rng = initialize_rng(seed)
    assert rng is not None, "RNG allocation failed"

    # Test with another seed
    seed = 654321
    rng = initialize_rng(seed)
    assert rng is not None, "RNG allocation failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
